description: Name search across official European registers, one schema. Local copies, all searched when pays is absent: Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Romania, Sweden, Spain (BORME base, hoja key); live, only with pays set: Czechia, Finland, Slovakia, Switzerland; Poland through GLEIF (no name search at the register); Denmark and the United Kingdom live, only with pays set; plus GLEIF (LEI) worldwide. Each match carries score_confiance (0-1). Order: match level first, served as correspondance_nom (exacte: the name, the official name in the French search, equals q once the legal forms written for the result's country are removed at either end of both, never the last word, for the countries of the closed list of written legal forms, a GLEIF result from any other country keeping its whole name; mots_entiers: every remaining word of q is a word of the name; ressemblance: the rest, an acronym or other-field hit included; null if q is a SIREN, SIRET or the result's national ID, or no name is served), then an internal ranking score, not score_confiance (European search: score_confiance before its cap at 1 and its rounding; French search: the similarity of the name, usual name and acronym, plus 0.05 for an active company, the name and acronym only in the real-time fallback); ties: by SIREN in the French search, one country in turn in the European search (rank by national ID within each country, then country code). nombre_resultats counts every servable result (tronque: true beyond the 10 served; note_troncature when a lower bound). Czechia, Estonia, Latvia, Norway and Slovakia serve legal persons only: a sole trader (in Estonia, a sole proprietorship, FIE; in Latvia, an individual merchant, IK, or an individual, family, farm or fishery enterprise; in Norway, a sole proprietorship, ENK, a registered individual or an estate; in Slovakia, any entity of the trade register, and one of the commercial register) or a form not recognised as a legal person is left out, and in Norway a foreign branch or entity (NUF, UTLA) whose name does not end with a legal-person form of its home country, or recorded there as a sole proprietorship; Croatia too (a trgovac pojedinac, t.p., or an undecided form); in Denmark, a sole proprietorship (ENK), a personally owned small business (PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form; in Lithuania, an individual enterprise (individuali įmonė, IĮ), its branch (individualios įmonės filialas) or representative office (individualios įmonės atstovybė), or an undecided form; in Sweden, a sole proprietorship (enskild näringsverksamhet) or an undecided form; in Romania, an authorised natural person or an individual or family enterprise (PFA, II, IF, PF, AF), never loaded, or an undecided form; in Finland, Ireland and the United Kingdom, a form outside the register's published nomenclature; in Belgium, an entity without legal form or off the whitelist; in Spain, a sole trader's hoja or one whose name has no company legal form of the closed Spanish list; in Switzerland, a sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen), a branch or an undecided form; in every country, a GLEIF LEI of a natural person (sole proprietor category or natural-person legal form) or of an ambiguous legal form is left out too, and a GLEIF LEI of a country with a local copy unless that copy serves its number; all are counted by reason in ecartes, never named, except an entity a local copy keeps nameless (neither matched nor counted: ecartes_non_mesures (LV, Latvia; NO, Norway) says so) and what a register's own request leaves out (ARES: legal persons only; GLEIF: its servable categories; neither read nor counted: ecartes_filtres_amont says so). A register or database outage returns 503 amont_indisponible or base_indisponible, never charged. Spanish matches give the hoja for get_spanish_company_acts. Paid via x402 ($0.003 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

pays.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country filter, e.g. NO, EE, LV

q.description: Company name (2 characters minimum once cleaned up, 3 with pays=CH). Unsupported characters are stripped, not rejected. A name too broad for Zefix (CH) or ARES (CZ) returns requete_trop_large, not charged: refine it.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: search_european_companies

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
